wiki.title: Glenn Thompson (politician)
wiki.extract: Glenn William "GT" Thompson Jr. is an American politician serving in the U.S. House of Representatives since 2009, representing Pennsylvania's 5th congressional district until 2019 and Pennsylvania's 15th congressional since then. He is a member of the Republican Party.
